Quellen: <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00171" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00171">[SWS_Eth_00171]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00266" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00266">[SWS_Eth_00266]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00270" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00270">[SWS_Eth_00270]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00271" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00271">[SWS_Eth_00271]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00272" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00272">[SWS_Eth_00272]</a></p> <h4>Transceiver-Steuerung über MII und Hardware-Zeitstempelung</h4> <p>Für den Zugriff auf Transceiver-Register über das MII stellt das Modul die asynchronen Dienste <code>Eth_WriteMii</code> und <code>Eth_ReadMii</code> bereit, welche über den Parameter <code>EthCtrlEnableMii</code> vorkompilierbar aktiviert werden <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00058" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00058">[SWS_Eth_00058]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00064" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00064">[SWS_Eth_00064]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00069" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00069">[SWS_Eth_00069]</a>. Neben Standard-Clause-22-Zugriffen <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00279" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00279">[SWS_Eth_00279]</a> unterstützt der Treiber erweiterte Clause-45-Registerzugriffe, die über Register 13 und 14 gemäß Annex 22D abgewickelt werden <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00273" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00273">[SWS_Eth_00273]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00274" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00274">[SWS_Eth_00274]</a>. Nach Beendigung des Hardwaretransfers werden die Ergebnisse asynchron über <code>EthTrcv_WriteMiiIndication</code> beziehungsweise <code>EthTrcv_ReadMiiIndication</code> an den Transceiver-Treiber gemeldet <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00241" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00241">[SWS_Eth_00241]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00242" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00242">[SWS_Eth_00242]</a>.</p> <p>Zur Unterstützung synchroner Zeitprotokolle (z. B. IEEE 802.1AS über Global Time Management, konfiguriert via <code>EthGlobalTimeSupport</code>) bietet das Modul präzise Zeitstempelfunktionen <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00210" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00210">[SWS_Eth_00210]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00211" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00211">[SWS_Eth_00211]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00212" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00212">[SWS_Eth_00212]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00213" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00213">[SWS_Eth_00213]</a>. Über <code>Eth_GetCurrentTime</code> lässt sich die aktuelle Hardwarezeit als <code>Eth_TimeStampType</code> mit zugehöriger Qualitätsangabe <code>Eth_TimeStampQualType</code> (<code>ETH_VALID</code>, <code>ETH_INVALID</code>, <code>ETH_UNCERTAIN</code>) abrufen <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00177" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00177">[SWS_Eth_00177]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00178" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00178">[SWS_Eth_00178]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00181" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00181">[SWS_Eth_00181]</a>. Egress-Zeitstempel werden vorab per <code>Eth_EnableEgressTimeStamp</code> für einen Puffer aktiviert und nach dem Senden mit <code>Eth_GetEgressTimeStamp</code> abgeholt <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00186" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00186">[SWS_Eth_00186]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00190" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00190">[SWS_Eth_00190]</a>. Für empfangene Rahmen liefert <code>Eth_GetIngressTimeStamp</code> den Aufnahmezeitpunkt anhand des Zeigers <code>Eth_DataType</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00161" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00161">[SWS_Eth_00161]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00195" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00195">[SWS_Eth_00195]</a>. Berechnungen von Zeitdifferenzen und Frequenzverhältnissen werden über <code>Eth_TimeIntDiffType</code> und <code>Eth_RateRatioType</code> strukturiert abgebildet <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00179" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00179">[SWS_Eth_00179]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00180" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00180">[SWS_Eth_00180]</a>.</p> <h4>Verhalten im Fehlerfall</h4> <p>Das Fehlermanagement unterscheidet strikt zwischen Entwicklungsfehlern (Development Errors) und erweiterten Produktionsfehlern (Extended Production Errors) <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00016" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00016">[SWS_Eth_00016]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00173" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00173">[SWS_Eth_00173]</a>. Ist die Erkennung von Entwicklungsfehlern aktiviert, prüfen alle API-Funktionen den Initialisierungszustand (<code>ETH_E_UNINIT</code>), die Gültigkeit des Controller-Index (<code>ETH_E_INV_CTRL_IDX</code>) sowie übergebene Zeigerparameter auf Nullzeiger (<code>ETH_E_PARAM_POINTER</code>) und melden Verstöße an das Default Error Tracer (DET) Modul <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00016" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00016">[SWS_Eth_00016]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00066" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00066">[SWS_Eth_00066]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00067" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00067">[SWS_Eth_00067]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00068" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00068">[SWS_Eth_00068]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00120" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00120">[SWS_Eth_00120]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00164" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00164">[SWS_Eth_00164]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00165" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00165">[SWS_Eth_00165]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00166" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00166">[SWS_Eth_00166]</a>. Ist DET deaktiviert, brechen betroffene Abfragefunktionen mit <code>E_NOT_OK</code> ab <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00228" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00228">[SWS_Eth_00228]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00229" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00229">[SWS_Eth_00229]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00230" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00230">[SWS_Eth_00230]</a>.</p> <p>Laufzeitfehler der Ethernet-Hardware werden als Dem-Events gemeldet: Ein fehlgeschlagener Registerzugriff triggert <code>ETH_E_ACCESS</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00039" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00039">[SWS_Eth_00039]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00173" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00173">[SWS_Eth_00173]</a>. Im Rahmen von <code>Eth_MainFunction</code> oder des Empfangsbetriebs festgestellte Pufferüberläufe und Frame-Verluste führen zum Ereignis <code>ETH_E_RX_FRAMES_LOST</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00169" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00169">[SWS_Eth_00169]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00174" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00174">[SWS_Eth_00174]</a>. Fehlerhafte Rahmen auf der Bitübertragungsschicht melden spezifische Produktionsfehler: Prüfsummenfehler triggern <code>ETH_E_CRC</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00172" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00172">[SWS_Eth_00172]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00219" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00219">[SWS_Eth_00219]</a>, Längenunter- oder -überschreitungen führen zu <code>ETH_E_UNDERSIZEFRAME</code> bzw. <code>ETH_E_OVERSIZEFRAME</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00220" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00220">[SWS_Eth_00220]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00221" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00221">[SWS_Eth_00221]</a>, und Fehlausrichtungen erzeugen <code>ETH_E_ALIGNMENT</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00222" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00222">[SWS_Eth_00222]</a>. Für Half-Duplex-Kollisionen stehen <code>ETH_E_SINGLECOLLISION</code>, <code>ETH_E_MULTIPLECOLLISION</code> und <code>ETH_E_LATECOLLISION</code> zur Verfügung <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00223" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00223">[SWS_Eth_00223]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00224" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00224">[SWS_Eth_00224]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00225" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00225">[SWS_Eth_00225]</a>. Zur Diagnose und Fehlerzählung stellt das Modul Schnittstellen gemäß IETF RFCs bereit: <code>Eth_GetCounterValues</code> (RFC 1757, RFC 1643, RFC 2233) <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00226" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00226">[SWS_Eth_00226]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_91007" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_91007">[SWS_Eth_91007]</a>, <code>Eth_GetRxStats</code> (RFC 2819) <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00233" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00233">[SWS_Eth_00233]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_91002" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_91002">[SWS_Eth_91002]</a> sowie <code>Eth_GetTxStats</code> und <code>Eth_GetTxErrorCounterValues</code> (RFC 1213) <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_91003" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_91003">[SWS_Eth_91003]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_91004" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_91004">[SWS_Eth_91004]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_91005" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_91005">[SWS_Eth_91005]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_91006" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_91006">[SWS_Eth_91006]</a>.</p> <h4>Weiterführende Detailbelege</h4> <p>Die Spezifikation des Ethernet-Treibers gliedert sich in fundamentale Kernfunktionalitäten und optionale Erweiterungspakete:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Lebenszyklus und Treiberzustand:</strong> Die grundlegende Initialisierung und Zustandsüberwachung stützen sich auf <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00027" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00027">[SWS_Eth_00027]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00034" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00034">[SWS_Eth_00034]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00159" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00159">[SWS_Eth_00159]</a> und <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00275" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00275">[SWS_Eth_00275]</a>; die Versionsabfrage erfolgt über <code>Eth_GetVersionInfo</code> gemäß <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00106" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00106">[SWS_Eth_00106]</a>.</li> <li><strong>Controller-Betriebsmodi:</strong> Das Umschalten und die Freigabe blockierter Pufferressourcen werden verbindlich in <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00137" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00137">[SWS_Eth_00137]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00276" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00276">[SWS_Eth_00276]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00280" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00280">[SWS_Eth_00280]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_91008" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_91008">[SWS_Eth_91008]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_91009" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_91009">[SWS_Eth_91009]</a> und <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_91010" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_91010">[SWS_Eth_91010]</a> geregelt.</li> <li><strong>Datenübertragung (Tx/Rx):</strong> Das Zusammenspiel aus Pufferreservierung, Versand und Indikation definieren <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00077" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00077">[SWS_Eth_00077]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00087" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00087">[SWS_Eth_00087]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00095" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00095">[SWS_Eth_00095]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00100" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00100">[SWS_Eth_00100]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00243" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00243">[SWS_Eth_00243]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00244" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00244">[SWS_Eth_00244]</a> und <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00256" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00256">[SWS_Eth_00256]</a>.</li> <li><strong>Adressfilterung und Hardware-Offload:</strong> MAC-Adressmanagement, Promiscuous-Modus und Prüfsummenentlastung basieren auf <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00052" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00052">[SWS_Eth_00052]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00146" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00146">[SWS_Eth_00146]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00147" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00147">[SWS_Eth_00147]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00150" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00150">[SWS_Eth_00150]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00151" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00151">[SWS_Eth_00151]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00152" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00152">[SWS_Eth_00152]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00216" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00216">[SWS_Eth_00216]</a> und <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00217" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00217">[SWS_Eth_00217]</a>.</li> <li><strong>Software-FIFOs und Credit-Shaper:</strong> Die Mechanismen zur Bandbreitenformung und PLCA-Burstübertragung sind spezifiziert in <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00263" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00263">[SWS_Eth_00263]</a> bis <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00272" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00272">[SWS_Eth_00272]</a>.</li> <li><strong>MII- und Zeitstempel-Dienste:</strong> Die Registerkommunikation mit Transceivern und Zeitstempelung zur Uhrensynchronisation folgen <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00058" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00058">[SWS_Eth_00058]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00064" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00064">[SWS_Eth_00064]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00181" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00195">[SWS_Eth_00195]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00273" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00273">[SWS_Eth_00273]</a> und <a Dem-/Det-Meldungen gründen auf <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00016" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00016">[SWS_Eth_00016]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00226" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Eth_00226">[SWS_Eth_00226]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Eth_00233" For reception the Ethernet Controller shall enable hardware capabilities to discard frames with mismatching protocol checksums (offloading) according to the following list: a) for IPv4 frames if EthCtrlEnableOffloadChecksumIPv4 is se t to TRUE b) for ICMP frames if EthCtrlEnableOffloadChecksumICMP is set to TRUE c) for TCP frames if EthCtrlEnableOffloadChecksumTCP is set to TRUE d) for UDP frames if EthCtrlEnableOffloadChecksumUDP is set to TRUE. In all other cases, the Ethernet Contro ller shall not consider the protocol checksum fields.
